import json, os, subprocess, statistics, sys, hashlib
from pathlib import Path

root=Path.cwd()
env=dict(os.environ,DOTNET_TieredCompilation='0')
dotnet=str(Path(os.environ['LOCALAPPDATA'])/'SharpPy/dotnet/dotnet.exe')
paths={'before':'.artifacts/round93-before-harness','after':'tools/PerformanceHarness/bin/Release/net8.0'}
historical='.artifacts/round91-before-harness'
diagnostic='--diagnostic' in sys.argv
names=('int_subclass_compare','int_subclass_float_compare') if diagnostic else ('int_subclass_compare','int_subclass_float_compare','mixed_compare_small','integer_compare','user_compare','dictionary')
results={}
for workload in names:
    selected=dict(paths)
    if not diagnostic and workload.startswith('int_subclass_'):
        selected['round90']=historical
    runs={side:[] for side in selected}
    for pair in range(1 if diagnostic else 3):
        for side in (list(selected) if pair%2==0 else list(reversed(selected))):
            p=subprocess.run([dotnet,str(root/selected[side]/'PerformanceHarness.dll'),('tools/PerformanceHarness/workloads.py' if workload=='dictionary' else 'tools/PerformanceHarness/numeric_comparison_workloads.py'),'100000','5' if diagnostic else '15',workload],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',check=True)
            data=json.loads(p.stdout)
            runs[side].append(data)
            print(workload,side,pair+1,statistics.median(data['results'][0]['milliseconds']),flush=True)
    results[workload]=runs
out='.artifacts/round93-diagnostic.json' if diagnostic else '.artifacts/round93-perf.json'
Path(out).write_text(json.dumps(dict(runs=results,dll_sha256={side:hashlib.sha256((root/path/'sharppy.dll').read_bytes()).hexdigest() for side,path in dict(paths,round90=historical).items()}),indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
